title: What capabilities should an identity orchestration platform provide for EUDI Wallet adoption? | Identity Infrastructure Explained
summary: Five capabilities an orchestration platform needs for EUDI Wallet adoption, from multi-wallet support to fallback, and how to test each one.
body_markdown:
An identity orchestration platform is ready for EUDI Wallet adoption when it provides five capabilities: connectivity to every certified wallet, routing that picks the right method for each user, a defined fallback sequence when the wallet path fails, credential handling that keeps signed data structured, and the ability to add the next wallet or method without a rebuild. Authologic's eID-native identity infrastructure is built around these five capabilities.


*Written by Florentyna Frend (Head of Product), Authologic.*
